# Vault UI telemetry events

Full list of all UI telemetry events emitted by Vault.

UI telemetry events are emitted when an operator enables UI telemetry and a user grants consent. Each event has a **name** and a set of **properties** that carry semantic context. No PII, secrets, or request bodies are ever included. Users may withdraw consent at any time via **User Preferences → Data Privacy**.

## Navigation

| Event type | Properties | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| UI Interaction | `namespace`, `action`, `elementId`, `channel` | Fired for every primary or sub-navigation item clicked in the sidebar. |

| Property | Possible values / Notes |
| :--- | :--- |
| `elementId` | `"nav-dashboard"`, `"nav-secrets"`, `"nav-auth-methods"`, `"nav-acl-policies"`, `"nav-namespaces"` |
| `channel` | `"webpage"` |

## Dashboard

### Quick actions

| Event type | Properties | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| CTA Clicked | `CTA`, `channel`, `location`, `objectType`, `uiElement`, `type`, `action`, `object` (optional) | Fired when a user clicks a call-to-action in the quick-actions widget or triggers a navigate action. |

| Property | Possible values / Notes |
| :--- | :--- |
| `CTA` | Button or link label |
| `objectType` | `"quick-actions-widget"` (CTA link clicks), `"secrets-engine-widget"` (navigate actions) |
| `uiElement` | `"quick-action-cta"`, `"quick-action-navigate"` |
| `type` | `"Link"`, `"Button"` |
| `action` | `"clicked"`, `"navigated"` |
| `object` | Secrets engine type, e.g. `"kv"`, `"pki"`. Only present on navigate actions. |

| Event type | Properties | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| UI Interaction | `namespace`, `action`, `elementId`, `channel`, `objectType`, `object` | Fired when a user clicks a specific engine row in the secrets engines dashboard widget. |

## Namespace wizard

### On selecting a security policy

| Event type | Properties | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| UI Interaction | `namespace`, `action`, `elementId`, `channel`, `location`, `object` | Fired when a user selects a security policy in step 1 of the namespace wizard. |

| Property | Possible values / Notes |
| :--- | :--- |
| `object` | `"flexible"` (single namespace), `"strict"` (multiple namespaces) |
| `elementId` | `"policy-toggle"` |
| `location` | `"step-1"` |

### On collapsing the tips section

| Event type | Properties | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| UI Interaction | `namespace`, `action`, `elementId`, `channel`, `location` | Fired once when a user collapses the tips reveal section in step 2 of the namespace wizard. |

| Property | Possible values / Notes |
| :--- | :--- |
| `elementId` | `"tips-reveal"` |
| `location` | `"step-2"` |

This event fires only on collapse, not on re-expand.

### On namespace field input

| Event type | Properties | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| UI Interaction | `namespace`, `action`, `elementId`, `channel`, `location` | Fired once per wizard session the first time a user types in the namespace name field. |

| Property | Possible values / Notes |
| :--- | :--- |
| `action` | `"typed"` |
| `elementId` | `"namespace-field"` |
| `location` | `"step-2"` |

This event is de-duplicated and fires at most once regardless of how many keystrokes occur.

### On selecting creation method

| Event type | Properties | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| UI Interaction | `namespace`, `action`, `elementId`, `channel`, `location` | Fired when a user selects how they want to create namespaces in step 3 of the wizard. |

| Property | Possible values / Notes |
| :--- | :--- |
| `action` | `"selected"` |
| `elementId` | `"method-selector"` |
| `location` | `"step-3"` |

The selected method (Terraform, CLI/API, or UI) determines which of the three event constants is used internally, but the IBM Tracking Plan event type is the same for all three.

## Resource creation

### Creating secrets engine

| Event type | Properties | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Created Object | `objectType`, `object`, `process`, `successFlag` | Fired when a user submits the enable secrets engine form, on both success and failure. |

| Property | Possible values / Notes |
| :--- | :--- |
| `objectType` | `"secrets-engine"` |
| `object` | Engine type, version-suffixed where applicable, e.g. `"kv-v2"`, `"pki"` |
| `process` | `"UI"` |
| `successFlag` | `true` (success), `false` (failure) |

| Event type | Properties | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Created Object | `objectType`, `object`, `process`, `quantity`, `successFlag` | Fired when the namespace wizard submits a creation request, on both success and failure. |
